zh.title: 土耳其空軍AS532 Cougar直升機訓練時墜毀 5人死亡
zh.summary: 土耳其空軍直升機11月24日在Eskisehir省訓練時墜毀，5人死亡
body: 土耳其空軍一架AS532 Cougar直升機2026年11月24日在西部的Eskisehir省執行訓練飛行時墜毀，造成5名空軍人員死亡。
土耳其國防部指出，遇難者包括兩名飛行員及三名士官，其中一人是航空器維修技術員。國防部於事故發生當天發布的聲明表示，直升機墜毀的原因當時尚未確定。
較早的一份聲明指出，這架直升機從Eskisehir起飛；救援人員已抵達直升機殘骸處，搜救行動當時仍在進行。

en.title: Turkish Air Force AS532 Cougar helicopter crashes on training flight, killing five
en.summary: A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashed during training in Eskisehir province on November 24, killing five.
body: A Turkish Air Force AS532 Cougar helicopter crashed during a training flight in the western province of Eskisehir on November 24, 2026, killing five Air Force personnel.

Turkey’s Ministry of National Defense identified those killed as two pilots and three noncommissioned officers, including an aircraft maintenance technician. In a statement published on the day of the crash, the ministry said the reason for the crash had not yet been determined.
An earlier statement said the helicopter had taken off from Eskisehir. Rescuers had reached the helicopter wreckage, and search-and-rescue operations were underway at the time.
